solution.text:
Cr NH 3 5 Cl Cl 2  and  Cr NH 3 4 Cl 2 Cl , both compounds will not show either structural or stereoisomerism.
Co NH 3 4 Cl 2 +  and  Pt NH 3 2 H 2 O Cl + , Ma4b2 type (octahedral), Ma2bc type (square planar) and both will show geometrical isomerism. ​
Co Br 2 Cl 2 2 -  and  Pt Br 2 Cl 2 2 - , Ma4b2 type (tetrahedral), Ma2b2 (square planar). ​
Pt NH 3 3 NO 3 Cl  and  Pt NH 3 3 Cl Br both will show ionisation isomerism. ​
